issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Pexo
products.tagline: Produce pitch perfect launch videos with precise control
products.summaryZh: 制作精准可控、音准完美的发布视频
products.descriptionZh: Pexo让制作发布视频像对话一样简单。分享你的产品、网站或素材，它会规划故事线，为每项任务选择合适的AI模型，生成并组装场景，处理配音、音乐、字幕、动态图形和剪辑。留下评论或圈出你想修改的地方，Pexo就会完成编辑。你只需指挥一个智能体，就能从创意到完成一部符合品牌调性的发布视频。
products.description: Pexo makes creating your launch video as simple as having a conversation. Share your product, website, or assets. It plans the story, chooses the right AI model for each task, generates and assembles the scenes, and handles voiceover, music, captions, motion graphics, and editing. Leave a comment or circle what you want changed, and Pexo makes the edit. You direct one agent from idea to a finished, on-brand launch video.

products.name: Ferndesk
products.tagline: The help center that never goes out of date
products.summaryZh: 永不过时的帮助中心
products.descriptionZh: Ferndesk 是一个完整的帮助中心，配备一个代理，它会对照你的产品检查每篇文章，捕捉变化，并为你起草修复方案。
products.description: Ferndesk is a complete help center with an agent that checks every article against your product, catches what changed, and drafts the fixes for you.

products.name: CrawlRaven MCP
products.tagline: Your SEO work, done from your AI agent
products.summaryZh: 你的SEO工作，由你的AI代理完成
products.descriptionZh: CrawlRaven 将 Search Console、GA4、你的关键词列表以及对网站的技术抓取整合成一份按影响力排序的计划：先修复什么、更新什么、撰写什么。通过我们的 MCP 服务器，在 Claude、ChatGPT 或 Cursor 中调用它，即可基于你自己的数据获得答案。
products.description: CrawlRaven joins Search Console, GA4, your keyword lists, and a technical crawl of your site into one plan, ranked by impact: what to fix, update and write first. Ask for it in Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor through our MCP server and get answers from your own data.

products.name: NotchDodo
products.tagline: NotchDodo turns your notch into a full-blown dashboard.
products.summaryZh: NotchDodo 将你的刘海变成功能完备的仪表盘。
products.descriptionZh: NotchDodo 将 Mac 的刘海变成日常工作流程中有用的一部分。🦤 内置 14 款工具，NotchDodo 让你快速调用实用小工具，不打断工作。它轻量、简单，专为带刘海的 Mac 设计。与其绕开刘海，不如让它发挥作用。14 款工具。一个刘海。一台更有用的 Mac。
products.description: NotchDodo turns your Mac’s notch into a useful part of your everyday workflow. 🦤 With 14 built-in tools, NotchDodo gives you quick access to handy utilities without interrupting your work. It’s lightweight, simple, and designed specifically for Macs with a notch. Instead of working around the notch, make it useful. 14 tools. One notch. A more useful Mac.

products.name: GitBot
products.tagline: Build bots on the coding agent you already use
products.summaryZh: 在你已使用的编码代理上构建机器人
products.descriptionZh: GitBot 把你反复交给 Claude Code、Codex 或 OpenCode 的任务变成一个机器人。只需编写一次指令，设定它可以触及的范围，就能在任何仓库中运行。每次运行都是一个可以随时回访的线程。你可以从库中安装其他开发者制作的机器人，也可以用代码分享你自己的。例如，ShipGuard 会读取你的分支并给出合并或阻止的结论，并附上文件和行号证据。它在你自己的机器上运行，使用你已有的登录信息。开源。无需账户，无遥测。
products.description: GitBot turns a job you keep giving Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode into a bot. Write the instructions once, set what it may touch, and run it in any repo. Each run is a thread you can come back to. Install bots other devs made from the Library, or share yours with a code. ShipGuard, for example, reads your branch and says merge or block, with file and line evidence. Runs on your machine with the logins you already have. Open source. No account, no telemetry.

products.name: Autonomyware
products.tagline: Idea to physical product, engineer anything you can imagine
products.summaryZh: 从创意到实体产品，工程实现你所能想象的一切
products.descriptionZh: Autonomyware 将你的想法转化为工程化的实体产品。从你的构想出发，让自主 AI 端到端处理整个工程流程。描述你想创造的东西，然后从产品定义推进到架构、风险、CAD、BOM、代码、验证和制造准备。一个 AI 原生工作空间让每一项决策和工程产物从想法到实现始终保持连接。
products.description: Autonomyware turns your idea into an engineered physical product. Start with your vision and let autonomous AI handle the engineering process end to end. Describe what you want to create, then move from product definition through architecture, risk, CAD, BOMs, code, verification, and manufacturing preparation. One AI-native workspace keeps every decision and engineering artifact connected from idea to implementation.

products.name: Upsolve Data Models
products.tagline: Teach AI your metric definitions and business vocabulary
products.summaryZh: 让 AI 学习你的指标定义和业务词汇
products.descriptionZh: 只需注册一次数据模型、指标定义和业务词汇。Upsolve 让每个智能体的回答都基于这些内容，像代码一样对其进行版本管理，并每晚刷新列值，因此随着数据变化，答案始终保持正确。
products.description: Register your data model, metric definitions and business vocabulary once. Upsolve grounds every agent answer in them, versions them like code and refreshes column values nightly, so answers stay correct as your data changes.

products.name: Datastory
products.tagline: Turn the world's data into stories worth sharing
products.summaryZh: 将世界的数据转化为值得分享的故事
products.descriptionZh: Datastory 是面向数据叙事者的无代码平台。借助 AI 创建交互式图表、网站和报告，并访问不断增长的开放数据集目录。
products.description: Datastory is the no-code platform for data storytellers. Create interactive charts, websites, and reports with AI, and access a growing catalog of open datasets.

products.name: Aktar
products.tagline: Share files instantly from your own cloud. Mac, Windows, iOS
products.summaryZh: 从你自己的云盘即时分享文件。支持 Mac、Windows、iOS
products.descriptionZh: Aktar 是一款免费、开源的应用，可通过你自己的 S3 兼容存储即时分享文件。拖入文件，Aktar 便会将其上传至 S3、Cloudflare R2、Backblaze B2、MinIO 或类似存储，然后将可分享的链接复制到你的剪贴板。适用于任何文件：截图、日志、构建产物、视频。无需账户，没有中间服务器，你的文件始终留在自己的存储中。现已支持 Mac、Windows 和 iOS，Android 版即将推出。
products.description: Aktar is a free, open-source app for instantly sharing files through your own S3-compatible storage. Drop a file and Aktar uploads it to S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, MinIO or similar storage, then copies the shareable link to your clipboard. Works with any file: screenshots, logs, builds, videos. No accounts, no intermediary servers, and your files stay in your own storage. Available on Mac, Windows and iOS, with Android coming soon.

products.name: Evlat
products.tagline: Know which AI coding agent is waiting on you
products.summaryZh: 知道哪个AI编程助手正在等你
products.descriptionZh: Evlat 是 Mac 屏幕边缘的一条细长条，每个 Claude Code 或 Codex 会话对应一个圆环。当某个会话需要授权或回答时，圆环会变成琥珀色；点击一下即可打开它的终端标签页。它还能跟踪长时间运行的命令和远程服务器。原生应用，无需权限。
products.description: Evlat is a thin strip on your Mac's screen edge, one ring per Claude Code or Codex session. When one needs a permission or an answer, it turns amber; one click opens its terminal tab. It also tracks long commands and remote servers. Native, no permissions.

products.name: jambuild
products.tagline: Near instant multiplayer vibecoding, just point and talk
products.summaryZh: 近乎即时的多人氛围编程，只需指向并开口说话
products.descriptionZh: 一款多人协作的vibecoding工具，你可以通过语音交流并用鼠标指点，每次修改几秒内即可生效。提供有限积分供试用，你也可以自带API密钥以解锁更多使用量。
products.description: A multiplayer vibecoding tool where you talk and point with your mouse, and every change lands in seconds. Has limited credits to try it out, and you can BYO API keys to unlock more usage.

products.name: CoIsland
products.tagline: Your whole engineering stack, in a notch
products.summaryZh: 你的整个工程栈，尽在一处。
products.descriptionZh: CoIsland 监控 CI、部署、错误、事故和数据库（35+ 连接器），只在 Mac 屏幕边缘的一个岛屿中显示出问题的部分。监控项就是普通的 SQL 或 shell 文件。一键即可将告警交给 Claude Code、Codex 或 Cortex Code。
products.description: CoIsland watches CI, deploys, errors, incidents and databases (35+ connectors) and shows only what breaks, in an island on the edge of your Mac's screen. Monitors are plain SQL or shell files. One click hands an alert to Claude Code, Codex or Cortex Code.

products.name: m’kay
products.tagline: One voice for all your coding agents, from your phone
products.summaryZh: 一个声音，掌控你所有的编码代理，尽在手机端
products.descriptionZh: 在任意浏览器或手机上，与你 Mac 上的 AI 代理对话。其他语音应用只能与一个助手对话。m’kay 能与你 Mac 上的所有代理对话：Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor。问问哪个已完成，听它回复，并在火车上或健身房里，通过手机浏览器告诉它下一步做什么。它驱动真实的桌面应用，因此你的会话和项目保持原样。在你对回读说“yes”之前，不会发送任何内容。开源：可完全在本地运行，或使用菜单栏 Mac 应用。
products.description: Talk to the AI agents on your Mac from any browser or phone. Other voice apps talk to one assistant. m’kay talks to all your agents: Claude Code, Codex and Cursor on your Mac. Ask which one is done, hear its reply, and tell it what to do next from your phone's browser, on the train, or at the gym. It drives the real desktop apps, so your sessions and projects stay where they are. Nothing is sent until you say "yes" to a read-back. Open source: run it all locally, or use the menu-bar Mac app.

products.name: Bruto
products.tagline: A task board that lives in your repo, for you and your AI
products.summaryZh: 一个存在于你的代码仓库中的任务看板，为你和你的 AI 服务。
products.descriptionZh: 一个粗野主义风格的任务板，用于与 AI 一起编码。笔记存放在你的仓库中：一键复制上下文，或让 agent 通过 MCP 处理任务板并在每条笔记中作答。常驻规则、跨项目链接，以及你的页面、API 和表格的地图。免费、开源。
products.description: A brutalist task board for coding with AI. Notes live in your repo: copy the context with one key, or let an agent work the board over MCP and answer in each note. Standing rules, cross-project links and a map of your pages, APIs and tables. Free, open source.

products.name: Macaly Cloud
products.tagline: Build and publish sites with your Claude or ChatGPT
products.summaryZh: 使用你的 Claude 或 ChatGPT 构建并发布网站
products.descriptionZh: 将 Macaly Cloud 添加到你的 Claude 或 ChatGPT，直接在对话中构建网站和应用。Macaly 提供数据库、托管、域名以及代码上线所需的 70 多项技能，使用你已订阅的方案即可。同样适用于 Claude Code、Codex 和 Grok Bot。
products.description: Add Macaly Cloud to your Claude or ChatGPT and build websites and apps right from the chat. Macaly provides the database, hosting, domain and 70+ skills the code needs to go live, on the subscription you already pay for. Also works in Claude Code, Codex and Grok Bot.

products.name: lurk
products.tagline: Free, open-source Reddit and Twitter lead monitoring
products.summaryZh: 免费、开源的Reddit和Twitter潜在客户监控
products.descriptionZh: lurk 会监控 Reddit 和 X，寻找那些在求推荐类似你产品的人，为每条帖子打分并附上一句理由，然后把新出现的帖子发送到邮箱、Slack、Discord 或 webhook。它还会找出 Google 上为你排名的 Reddit 帖子。免费且开源。
products.description: lurk watches Reddit and X for people asking for a product like yours, scores each post with a one-line reason, and sends new ones to email, Slack, Discord or a webhook. Also finds the Reddit threads Google ranks for you. Free and open source.

products.name: OpenShip
products.tagline: Open source PaaS on your server or in the cloud. No lock in.
products.summaryZh: 开源 PaaS，可部署在你的服务器或云端。无锁定。
products.descriptionZh: OpenShip 是一个开源 PaaS，可运行在我们的云或你的基础设施上。推送代码后，OpenShip 会处理构建、部署、域名、SSL、监控、备份、密钥以及应用依赖的服务。你可以从 OpenShip Cloud 的全托管方案开始，也可以在自己的云或本地环境中自托管。在两者之间迁移时，无需改变部署方式。没有专有运行时。没有供应商锁定。移除 OpenShip 后，你的应用仍可继续运行。部署任何东西。掌控一切。
products.description: OpenShip is an open source PaaS that runs on our cloud or your infrastructure. Push your code and OpenShip handles builds, deployments, domains, SSL, monitoring, backups, secrets, and the services your apps depend on. Start fully managed on OpenShip Cloud or self host on your own cloud or on prem. Move between them without changing how you deploy. No proprietary runtime. No vendor lock in. Remove OpenShip and your apps keep running. Deploy anything. Own everything.

products.name: Flocker Agent Profiles
products.tagline: Profile Pages for Agents: your live AI collaboration network
products.summaryZh: 代理个人资料页：你的实时AI协作网络
products.descriptionZh: 再也不会丢失上下文！为你的 Agent 提供个人主页、实时动态和个人存储。随时随地访问，连接更多以构建你的私有 agent 网络。给每个 agent 一个职位头衔！有了清晰的职位描述，AI 表现更出色。登录并让你的 agent 创建新的 Agent Profile，以实现自管理上下文、协作式 agent 工作流和任务管理。兼容你常用的所有 AI 工具，包括 Claude Code、Codex、Hermes 和 OpenClaw。
products.description: Never lose context again! Give your Agent a profile page, live feed, and personal storage. Access it anywhere, and connect more to build your private agent network. Give every agent a job title! AI works better with a clear job description. Log-in and ask your agent to create a new Agent Profile for self-managed context, collaborative agent workflows and task management. Works with all your favourite AI tools incl. Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, and OpenClaw.

products.name: SelfJev
products.tagline: Jev-compatible self-hosted decisions mode
products.summaryZh: 兼容 Jev 的自托管决策模式
products.descriptionZh: SelfJev 是一个可自行托管的开放 4B 决策模型。针对任意文本提出类型化问题（是/否、单选、多选、评分），即可获得校准后的概率。兼容 Jev：只需设置两个环境变量，即可将 TypeSafe 的 SDK 指向你的服务器。还可基于你的数据对其进行微调。
products.description: SelfJev is an open 4B decisions model you host yourself. Ask typed questions about any text (yes/no, pick one, pick any, score) and get calibrated probabilities. Jev-compatible: point TypeSafe's SDK at your server with two env vars. Fine-tune it on your data.

products.name: Bevell
products.tagline: CAD automation where it counts.
products.summaryZh: 在关键环节实现CAD自动化。
products.descriptionZh: 不再手工重绘零件。将照片、草图、扫描件或 PDF 转换为可直接切割、铣削或打印的文件。获得可编辑的 DXF 和真实比例 SVG。免费预览无限次转换。Bevell Sketchpad 现已进入测试阶段。
products.description: Stop redrawing parts by hand. Turn a photo, sketch, scan or PDF into a file you can cut, mill or print. Get an editable DXF and true-scale SVG. Preview unlimited conversions for free. Bevell Sketchpad now in beta.
